topic: 世界模型需要什么样的训练数据

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): 同时覆盖世界模型的训练数据、动作忠实、可采信性和策略评估用途。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-admissibility
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:admissibility OR all:trustworthiness OR all:reliability) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖世界模型能否承担策略评估的可采信性。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-action-fidelity
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"action following" OR all:"action-conditioned reliability") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖动作响应而非仅视觉逼真。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-policy-evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:"policy evaluation" AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖世界模型作为策略评测器。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-physically-viable-world-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"physical viability" OR all:"physics adherence" OR all:"physically viable") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖物理约束与失败乐观偏差。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-action-conditioned-training-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:"action-conditioned" AND (all:data OR all:dataset) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖动作干预后的状态变化数据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-contact-world-model-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:contact OR all:tactile OR all:force) AND all:"robot manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖接触与不可观测物理状态。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-failure-recovery-rollouts
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:failure OR all:recovery OR all:intervention) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖失败、纠错和恢复轨迹。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-key-event-world-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:keyframe OR all:"key event" OR all:sparse) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖关键事件保留与高效时序采样。
